pr_body:
Solves https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/113368

Enabling otel-data by default.

### Testing

I removed `setting("xpack.otel_data.registry.enabled", "true")` from tests, so naturally all test will assume default config and test that the plugin is turned on.
pr_comment:
This isn't really about the usage of synthetic _source itself but is related to this fallback check for LogsDB

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/4318ebbe8f48d58e9471b3ae0519495be0981c48/x-pack/plugin/logsdb/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/logsdb/SyntheticSourceLicenseService.java#L46-L55

By calling `check`, the `synthetic-source` feature usage gets tracked.
@martijnvg I wonder if it makes sense do adjust the way the fallback is implemented to not consider executing the fallback check usage of synthetic _source. I'd argue that actual usage only happens when an index is created with synthetic _source being used (which is not checked at all at the moment).

By enabling the OTel logs and traces data streams [which are using LogsDB by default](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/4318ebbe8f48d58e9471b3ae0519495be0981c48/x-pack/plugin/otel-data/src/main/resources/component-templates/logs-otel%40mappings.yaml#L9), ES always executes this fallback check.

This trips the following test that assert that no features should be used by starting up with default configuration:

 * https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/logsdb/src/javaRestTest/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/logsdb/LogsdbRestIT.java
* https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/src/yamlRestTest/resources/rest-api-spec/test/license/10_feature_usage.yml

So synthetic source usage will be checked once this PR gets merged: #113759

But I think for index template we should use: `SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_FEATURE.checkWithoutTracking(...)` instead of `SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_FEATURE.check(...)`. The later should only be used when an actual index gets created.

I can work on a PR for that.

review_comment: By setting default to `true`, we kind of loose this. Is this relevant?I think we could still do stage rollout by setting it to `false` in serverless and gradually removing it.

I might be missing something but I don't see much advantage of staged rollout. IIUC, the OTEL-data plugin will be engaged only when the OTEL mode will be used with the es-exporter which kind of gates the usage anyway.
Yeah I think that may have come from me, but in retrospect it's not necessary. It was important for apm-data because of the impact on a GA product, but that's not the case here.
